title: European Battery Circularity Association: recycling value chain worth EUR 3.4 billion in 2025
text: The European Battery Circularity Association (EBCA) puts the 2025 value of the European lithium-ion battery recycling value chain at EUR 3.4 billion, up 18% from EUR 2.9 billion in 2024. EBCA's figure covers the EU-27 plus EFTA countries and the United Kingdom, includes all lithium-ion feedstock (EV packs, production scrap and portable batteries) and adds the market value of recovered nickel, cobalt, lithium and copper to service revenue. EBCA members operate 41 recycling sites. The figures come from the association's annual Circularity Report (doc_id: ebca-circularity-report-2025).
